notes: Vanilla canvas 2D, zero libraries. Sunset-dusk palette with stars, sun glow, and slow clouds. Parallax layers: far/mid/near hills, two tree bands, utility poles with sagging wires, asphalt road with scrolling dashes and flecks, near-foreground grass at 1.35x. Seeded hash scenery for a seamless varied loop. Coupe with gradient body, glass, 5-spoke rolling wheels, bounce/pitch, headlight beam and taillight. HDPI canvas, space/click to pause.
